name: Control Ultimate Edition
notes: Northlight DX12 → D3DMetal. Steam's default launch target is Control.exe, a WinForms DX11/DX12 picker (Mono/.NET), not the engine. Launch Control_DX12.exe directly with SteamAppId=870780 so Steamworks still initialises. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk. DLSS (nvngx_dlss.dll) cannot run on Apple Silicon; the in-game toggle should disable itself. Ray tracing is DXR via D3DMetal and is viable on M3/M4. First run will hitch on PSO translation (DXIL→AIR); subsequent runs cache. renderer.ini lives in the game folder after the first boot.
